senses.gloss:
GLIP:
I To embrace, encompass: q. v.
II
To shear, cut off: कल्पति (क्ल्ट्प्, c. l), (rare),
with hair, nails, and beard c. ped:
कॢप्तकेशनखश्मश्रः,
M. iv. 35.
III To curtail: q. v.

GLIB:
I Slippery: पिच्छिलः (ला, लं).
II
Voluble: चपलः (ला, लं).

GLIBNESS:
I Slipperiness: पिच्छिलता।
II
Volubility: चपलता।

GLIDE:
I Of time: याति (या, c. 2.): v. To
go.
II Of rivers: स्रवति (स्रु, c. 1.): v. To
flow.
III To move on: प्रचलति (चल्, c. 1.).

GLIMMERING (adj.): मन्दं मन्दं ज्वलत् (f. न्ती);
मन्दप्रभः (भा, भं) (with faint light), B.

GLISTEN, GLISTER: द्योतते (द्युत्, c. 1.): v. To
gleam, shine. G. ing: v. Bright, brilliant.

GLITTERING: ज्वलत् (न्ती), प्र-,
g. energy:
ज्वलत्प्रतापः,
N.: v. Bright, brilliant.
